dataIdInfo.idAbs: This is a point data set representing all streetlight locations within Boise Area of Impact. A streetlight is a light, usually mounted on a pole, and constituting one of a series of lights spaced at intervals along a public street or highway. This data set was developed by Boise City Public Works Department in the early 1990's and is currently maintained by the DIS Division of Boise City Public Works under the direction of the Boise City Streetlight Coordinator. This data set is updated continually by Boise City GIS and other staff, and represents the current state of streetlights for the Boise City Area of Impact.
